final_text:
I emailed New Asiaway's private-dining address, privatedining@contact-mail.org, asking for a table for 12 next Friday. The email asks them to reply with availability and open time slots. It includes your name, company, email and phone number.

- **Date:** I wrote "next Friday" and didn't give a calendar date, because I couldn't confirm today's date. The send timestamp reads 2026-10-12, but your calendar entries are from May 2024. If you want, I can send a follow-up with the exact date and a preferred time.
- **Extra address:** The review also asked for a separate copy to go to privatedining.wo
